description: Evidence-grounded legal-operations preparation with explicit lawyer/Principal escalation and no final authority.

routing.when_to_use: Use for evidenced legal-matter intake, plain-English summaries, obligation/renewal review, playbook comparison, and human escalation.
when_not_to_use: Do not use for final legal advice, legal representation, jurisdiction selection, or privilege determinations.
Do not use to sign, accept, negotiate, send, file, renew, terminate, or mutate legal records.
Do not use with live contract text, customer data, privileged material, credentials, or private company data.
exclusion_rules: Lawyer or Principal owns final legal decisions.
LiNKskills prepares evidence and choices only; external legal systems remain consumer-owned.

required_inputs.name: matter
required_inputs.description: Synthetic matter reference, workflow, jurisdiction status, source evidence, authority, and privacy classification.

expected_outputs.name: result
expected_outputs.description: Evidence-backed summary, register, comparison, refusal, or escalation with no live effects.

execution.procedure_summary: Qualify sources, extract evidenced obligations, compare to an approved playbook, and escalate unresolved legal authority.
forbidden_actions: Store or echo live contract text, privileged material, credentials, customer data, or private company data
Provide final legal advice or choose jurisdiction
Sign, accept, negotiate, send, file, renew, terminate, or mutate legal records
verification_steps: Run scoped contract and boundary tests
Confirm synthetic-only fixtures, no live effects, and explicit rollback

telemetry.retention_policy: retain synthetic IDs, evidence hashes, source refs, and receipts only
